name: DOHMH and DEP Waterborne Disease Risk Assessment Program Annual Report Data: Percentage of interviewed cryptosporidiosis case-patients reporting selected potential risk exposures before disease onset, by Immune Status
description: This dataset contains annual summary statistics from the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) and Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) Waterborne Disease Risk Assessment Program. It reports the percentage of interviewed cryptosporidiosis case-patients who reported selected potential risk exposures before illness onset, broken down by immune status (persons with HIV/AIDS versus immunocompetent persons). Each row represents one year from 1995 through 2022, and the columns hold the corresponding percentages for different exposure categories within each immune-status group. The column names are somewhat generic (for example, persons_with_hiv_aids_contact, persons_with_hiv_aids_high, and similarly named immunocompetent_persons columns), so the specific exposure each column represents is not fully spelled out in the data itself. Values are stored as percentage strings such as "35%". The data can be used to track trends over time in reported exposures among cryptosporidiosis patients, compare exposure patterns
